judgements.justification: A's reviewers and AC judged the paper's fairness motivation unsupported (fairness never defined, objective pure utility) and stopped at poster over these 'major presentation concerns', while B's reviewers took the policing and lending framing as a strength.
A's ratings were 6, 6, 7, 7 at confidence 3 to 4, and no A reviewer said it could not check the technical core; the scores were not flat marginal-accept votes from unsure reviewers.
